description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to plugin slot management in a software project, including slot key mappings, normalization, comparison, and exclusive slot selection logic.

methods.name: normalizeKinds
methods.description: Normalizes a PluginKind or array of PluginKind into an array for uniform processing.

methods.name: hasKind
methods.description: Checks if a plugin's kind field includes a specific target kind.

methods.name: slotKeyForPluginKind
methods.description: Returns the slot key associated with a single PluginKind.

methods.name: kindsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two PluginKind or PluginKind[] values are equivalent, order-insensitive.

methods.name: slotKeysForPluginKind
methods.description: Returns all slot keys that a plugin's kind field maps to.

methods.name: defaultSlotIdForKey
methods.description: Returns the default slot ID for a given slot key.

methods.name: applyExclusiveSlotSelection
methods.description: Applies an exclusive slot selection, updating configuration and generating warnings if changes occur.
